The [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] worked out of a '''laboratory''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. He vacated it before [[138 ABY]]. When the crew of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] came to Daluuj with an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] him, they found the laboratory abandoned. After doing [[Mission to Daluuj|battle]] with a contingent of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed there, they set explosives and destroyed the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]].
